notes.title: Minor Update to “Toyland Tussle”
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45683280/6a4a109421dc38c652e51175889e6217c4715e7c.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45683280/f17c6ca9ef0bae9e86092be093c320be818e856f.png"]- New control schemes for keyboards, for both Normal and Looney options.
- Fullscreen Switch key changed from 'F' to 'P'.
- Increased clarity on difficulty selection screen.
- Script updates to all cutscenes.
- Fixed how ranking calculates level time.
- Reduced space on disk.
